It is not

> "DeepSeek Harness" are trademarks of their respective"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" owners; they are
> referenced here only to describe what this plugin runs against."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Read-only security and compliance plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Also listed in awesome-dsh-plugin · Awesome DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- Peer dependency: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` — the authoritative range is in
package.json. It is opti"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"onal, so installing the plugin never
pulls a second copy of the DSH core tree.
- CI verifies the reg"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"istration / execution / rendering contract against the
real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` at **0.1.0-rc.6"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"**, **0.1.2-rc.1**,
**0.1.7-rc.2**, **0.2.0-rc.2**, **0.2.1-rc.5** and **0.2.2-alpha.2**
(job `host-"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"compat` in ci.yml). DSH itself is
pre-1.0: pin your DSH version and re-run `security_audit` after up"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"grading
either side.
- No install-time scripts and no build step; the shipped source is the artifact"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"rading
either side.
- No install-time scripts and no build step; the shipped source is the artifact."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"Four tools and one skill:"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| Capability | Tool | What it does |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| Prompt-injection detection | `security_scan_text` | Rule engine (English + Chinese) with per-text "},{"id":"p11s2","text":"LRU caching, split rule/model caches, fail-open timeout and truncation policies (configurable fail-c"},{"id":"p11s3","text":"losed), a pluggable model classifier, and an obfuscation-resistance layer (zero-width/full-width/hom"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"oglyph normalization + bounded base64 decoding, ruleset v6). Returns `allow` / `review` / `block`, `"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"riskScore`, `decisionConfidence`, `scanComplete`, a `riskLevel`, and an `inputSha256` for replayable"},{"id":"p11s6","text":" decisions. |
| PII redaction | `security_redact_text` | Masks the supported CN mobile, CN ID card, "},{"id":"p11s7","text":"CN bank card, email, IPv4, API key, and URL-credential patterns; other sensitive types still need re"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"view. |
| Structured JSON redaction | `security_redact_json` | Recursively redacts sensitive values "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"inside JSON by key name (`api_key`, `token`, `secret`, `password`, `authorization`, ...) plus a PII "},{"id":"p11s10","text":"fallback on other values. The structure is preserved — safe to hand tool-call arguments or session c"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"ontext to a third-party model. |
| Local security audit | `security_audit` | 11 read-only checks acr"},{"id":"p11s12","text":"oss config / sessions / plugins / paths / network / env / host, mapped to OWASP LLM + Agentic Top 10"},{"id":"p11s13","text":", with `quick|full` profile tiers, Linux `/proc/net` wildcard-bind ground truth, an offline plugin s"},{"id":"p11s14","text":"upply-chain inventory (opt-in live registry check), and a deterministic, redacted report with a self"},{"id":"p11s15","text":"-checksum (`reportSha256`). |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## Security model"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"What this plugin does about itself:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- No write paths in the audit. Audit checks are `stat`/`readdir`/`readFile`/env/`os` reads only; the"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" plugin's single write is the opt-in `logFile` audit log (append-only).
- Redaction is on every outp"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ut path: scan snippets, audit evidence, log lines, and structured JSON. `lib/logger.js` masks PII in"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" any field named `text`/`content`/`evidence`/`snippet`/`value`; `security_redact_json` scrubs sensit"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ive key values by name; secrets are never persisted or echoed.
- Fail-open by default: timeout downg"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"rades to `allow` with an explicit warning, so the security feature cannot become an availability pro"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"blem. Sensitive flows can set `onTimeout: review|block` for fail-closed behavior.
- Load-time schema"},{"id":"p14s8","text":" validation: every tool output schema is asserted with `assertObjectJsonSchema` at plugin start, so "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"a schema regression fails loudly instead of surfacing at runtime.
- Self-checksums: scan results car"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"ry `inputSha256` and audit reports carry `reportSha256`, so decisions and reports can be replayed an"},{"id":"p14s11","text":"d verified locally.
- Errors are sanitized: a failing check reports `status: "error"` with a generic"},{"id":"p14s12","text":" message, no stack traces or internal paths.
- No hard dependencies beyond the DSH-provided `@deepse"},{"id":"p14s13","text":"ek-ai/dsh-tools`; `lib/` uses only Node builtins."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Limitations and disclaimer"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"This plugin is a read-only, heuristic aid. It is not a security product, not
a certification, and no"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"t a substitute for a proper threat model. Read this
before relying on it."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**Detection is heuristic.**"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- The injection rules are a fixed pattern table (English + Chinese). They can
miss novel or obfuscat"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"ed attacks (false negatives) and can over-flag
benign phrasing (false positives). `allow` means "no "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"rule fired", not
"safe". Coverage is reported separately: `scanComplete: false` means the
input was "},{"id":"p18s4","text":"truncated or the budget expired, and the decision follows
`onTruncate` / `onTimeout` (default `allow"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"`). `npm run eval` publishes the
current false-positive / false-negative rates per language over the"},{"id":"p18s6","text":" corpus
in `tests/fixtures/adversarial-samples.js`.
- The optional model classifier runs only on `re"},{"id":"p18s7","text":"view` verdicts, only when
configured, and depends on a local model you operate (the built-in adapter"},{"id":"p18s8","text":"
targets Ollama / Llama-Guard). Without a classifier, ambiguous cases stay
at `review` for a human."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"**Redaction is type-limited.**"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- Only the listed PII types are masked (CN mobile / ID / bank card, email,
IPv4, API keys, URL crede"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ntials). Chinese names, addresses, and other
context-sensitive PII are NOT covered. Regex + structur"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"al validation cuts
false positives (order numbers) but cannot guarantee zero misses."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"**The audit is a posture snapshot.**"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"- Eleven fixed checks; every report carries a `limitations` field stating what
that run does not cov"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"er.
- File-permission checks use POSIX mode bits; **Windows ACLs are not
inspected** (Node has no na"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"tive ACL API).
- Live listening-port ground truth runs on **Linux only** (`/proc/net`);
other platfo"},{"id":"p22s4","text":"rms rely on env/config evidence.
- Session-file PII sampling covers up to 10 files by default; raise"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"
`sampleLimit` for large session directories.
- The live `deps-supply-chain` registry lookup is **op"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"t-in**
(`supplyChainLive: true`) and sends installed plugin names+versions to
registry.npmjs.org; of"},{"id":"p22s7","text":"fline inventory is the default.
- Absence of findings does not imply the machine is secure."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**Compatibility.**"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- See Compatibility above. The tested host versions are
